Package be.imgn.swing.wizard

@NullMarked package be.imgn.swing.wizard
Wizards: a dialog view's steps, with Previous, Next and Finish, each step validated before the next.

    Wizard
    Shows the content of a dialog view as a sequence of steps, with Previous and Next, each step validated before the next: the view injects it, returns what Wizard.steps returns from its content(), or places it, and returns what Wizard.buttons(StandardCommands) returns from its buttons.
